# Remaining schemas, part 2 (BookingWriteRequest–WhoAmI)

Every schema whose fields the domain and capability references do not already lay out: request wrappers, list envelopes, protocol objects, action results and payment variants. Listed here so the plugin covers all 139 schemas in the specification.

## List envelopes

Array wrappers with no fields of their own. The item schema carries everything.

- **CapabilityList**: array of `Capability`. Returned by `GET /capabilities`.
- **ProductList**: array of `Product`. Returned by `GET /products`.
- **SupplierList**: array of `Supplier`.

## `BookingWriteRequest`

Shared booking request shape for booking write operations.

Required: `productId`, `optionId`, `availabilityId`, `unitItems`.

- **productId** (string, required): Product identifier. Example: `"e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681"`.
- **optionId** (string, required): Option identifier. Example: `"94cdd032-3d32-416d-b0a4-abf8b7495b8b"`.
- **availabilityId** (string, required): Availability identifier (date or date-time). Example: `"2026-05-14T09:00:00-04:00"`.
- **unitItems** (BookingUnitItemWriteRequest[], required): List of unit item values.
- **contact** (Contact, optional): Contact object. Required if `options[x].requiredContactFields` from the products response has values.
- **currency** (string, optional): ISO 4217 currency code. Example: `"USD"`.
- **deliveryMethod** (string, optional): Delivery method value. Example: `"VOUCHER"`.
- **emailReceipt** (boolean, optional): Whether email receipt is enabled. Example: `true`.
- **expirationMinutes** (integer, optional): Expiration minutes numeric value. Example: `30`.
- **metadata** (Metadata, optional): Metadata object.
- **notes** (string, optional): Notes value. Example: `"Vegetarian meal requested"`.
- **quote** (boolean, optional): Whether quote is enabled. Example: `false`.
- **resellerReference** (string, optional): Reseller reference value. We highly recommend including a `resellerReference`. Example: `"RES-BOOK-10045"`.
- **settlementMethod** (string, optional): Settlement method value. Example: `"DIRECT"`.
- **tags** (string[], optional): List of tag values. Example: `["vip", "partner"]`.
- **uuid** (string (uuid), optional): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **cardPayment** (CardPaymentRequest, optional): From capability `octo/cardPayments`.
- **returnUrl** (string (uri), optional): From capability `octo/cardPayments`. Example: `"https://checkout.city-sightseeing.com/return"`.

With `octo/cart`:

- **orderId** (string, optional). Example: `"ord_20260514_9f3c21"`.

With `octo/content`:

- **termsAccepted** (boolean, optional). Example: `true`.

With `octo/extras`:

- **extraItems** (ExtraItemRequest[], optional): Send one object per reserved extra. Include `retail` for custom retail extras.

With `octo/gifts`:

- **giftPayment** (GiftPayment, optional).

With `octo/identities`:

- **identityId** (string, optional, nullable). Example: `"identity_customer_001"`.

With `octo/memberships`:

- **appendMembershipValidity** (boolean, optional). Example: `true`.
- **membership** (MembershipContext, optional).

With `octo/offers`:

- **offerCode** (string, optional). Example: `"SUMMER25"`.

With `octo/pickups`:

- **dropoffAddress** (string, optional): Optional address used to improve dropoff hotel geocoding when `dropoffHotel` is provided. Example: `"2500 Mason St, San Francisco, CA 94133"`.
- **dropoffHotel** (string, optional): Hotel name for dropoff selection. Example: `"Hotel Riu Plaza Fisherman's Wharf"`.
- **dropoffNotes** (string, optional). Example: `"Drop-off at Fisherman's Wharf."`.
- **dropoffPointId** (string (uuid), optional): Selected dropoff point UUID. If both `dropoffPointId` and `dropoffHotel` are sent, `dropoffPointId` takes precedence. Example: `"8d7a2fd8-f8f8-4e61-bbaf-5adac58f5d46"`.
- **dropoffRequested** (boolean, optional). Example: `true`.
- **pickupAddress** (string, optional): Optional address used to improve pickup hotel geocoding when `pickupHotel` is provided. Example: `"333 O'Farrell St, San Francisco, CA 94102"`.
- **pickupHotel** (string, optional): Hotel name for pickup selection. Example: `"Hilton Union Square"`.
- **pickupHotelRoom** (string, optional). Example: `"1208"`.
- **pickupNotes** (string, optional). Example: `"Meet the guide by the hotel lobby."`.
- **pickupPointId** (string (uuid), optional): Selected pickup point UUID. If both `pickupPointId` and `pickupHotel` are sent, `pickupPointId` takes precedence. Example: `"1cfe2c68-4a91-4df8-8d69-4b393d469caf"`.
- **pickupRequested** (boolean, optional). Example: `true`.

With `octo/questions`:

- **questionAnswers** (QuestionAnswer[], optional).

With `octo/rentals`:

- **rentalDurationId** (string, optional). Example: `"rental_duration_2h"`.

With `octo/resources`:

- **resourceAllocations** (ResourceAllocation[], optional).

With `octo/waivers`:

- **waiverFieldValues** (WaiverFieldValue[], optional): Waiver field values for booking-level waivers. Required with `waiverId` when submitting a booking-level waiver.
- **waiverFile** (string, optional, nullable): Optional base64-encoded waiver file payload for offline/in-person completed waivers, or to store a rendered waiver copy on the booking. Use a PDF data URI such as `data:application/pdf;base64,...`. Example: `"data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQKJcTl8uXr..."`.
- **waiverId** (string (uuid), optional, nullable): Waiver template UUID selected for booking-level waivers. Required with `waiverFieldValues` when submitting a booking-level waiver. Example: `"6d8c49eb-d6d3-4f03-a242-6f5f95f4d56f"`.

## `CancelRequest`

- **reason** (string, optional): Reason for the requested action. Example: `"Customer request"`.

## `Capability`

Returned by `GET /capabilities`.

Required: `id`, `revision`, `required`, `dependencies`.

- **id** (string, required): Capability ID to include in the `Octo-Capabilities` header. Example: `"octo/waivers"`.
- **revision** (integer, required): Supported capability revision. Example: `1`.
- **required** (boolean, required): Whether this capability is required for the product. Example: `false`.
- **dependencies** (string[], required): Capability IDs required when this capability is requested. Example: `[]`.
- **docs** (string (uri), optional, nullable): Capability documentation URL. Example: `"https://docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/waivers"`.

## `DeleteResult`

Returned by `DELETE /identities/{identityId}`, `DELETE /notifications/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}`, `DELETE /webhooks`, `DELETE /webhooks/{webhookId}`.

Required: `success`.

- **success** (boolean, required): Whether success is enabled. Example: `true`.
- **message** (string, optional): Message value. Example: `"Deleted successfully."`.

## `Error`

Error response payload returned by OCTO APIs.

Returned by `POST /checkin/lookup`.

Required: `error`, `errorMessage`.

- **amount** (integer, optional, nullable): Amount numeric value. Example: `22000`.
- **availabilityId** (string, optional, nullable): Availability identifier (local date or local date-time). Example: `"2026-05-14T09:00:00-04:00"`.
- **currency** (string, optional, nullable): ISO 4217 currency code. Example: `"USD"`.
- **currencyPrecision** (integer, optional, nullable): Number of decimal places for currency amounts. Example: `2`.
- **error** (string, required): Error value. Example: `"BAD_REQUEST"`.
- **errorCode** (string, optional, nullable): Error code value. Example: `"INVALID_OPTION_ID"`.
- **errorMessage** (string, required): Error message value. Example: `"The request payload is invalid."`.
- **optionId** (string, optional, nullable): Option identifier. Example: `"94cdd032-3d32-416d-b0a4-abf8b7495b8b"`.
- **productId** (string, optional, nullable): Product identifier. Example: `"e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681"`.
- **retryAfter** (integer, optional, nullable): Retry after numeric value. Example: `2`.
- **unitId** (string, optional, nullable): Unit identifier. Example: `"unit_adult"`.
- **uuid** (string, optional, nullable): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **cardPaymentId** (string, optional, nullable): From capability `octo/cardPayments`. Example: `"cp_20260514_42ad10"`.

With `octo/cart`:

- **orderId** (string, optional, nullable). Example: `"ord_20260514_9f3c21"`.

With `octo/pricing`:

- **availableCurrencies** (string[], optional). Example: `["USD", "EUR"]`.
- **pricing** (Pricing, optional).

## `Gift`

Returned by `DELETE /gifts/{uuid}`, `GET /gifts`, `GET /gifts/{uuid}`, `PATCH /gifts/{uuid}`, `PATCH /gifts/{uuid}/preview`, `POST /gifts`, `POST /gifts/{uuid}/cancel`, `POST /gifts/{uuid}/confirm`, `POST /gifts/{uuid}/extend`.

Required: `currency`, `status`, `uuid`.

- **active** (boolean, optional): Whether active is enabled. Example: `true`.
- **agent** (BookingActor, optional, nullable): Agent value.
- **alias** (string, optional, nullable): Alias value. Example: `"booking-alias-001"`.
- **amount** (number (float), optional): Amount numeric value. Example: `200.0`.
- **cancellable** (boolean, optional): Whether cancellable is enabled. Example: `true`.
- **cancellation** (BookingCancellation, optional, nullable): Cancellation value.
- **confirmable** (boolean, optional): Whether confirmable is enabled. Example: `true`.
- **contact** (Contact, optional): Contact object.
- **currency** (string, required): ISO 4217 currency code. Example: `"USD"`.
- **deliveryMethods** (string[], optional): List of delivery method values. Example: `["VOUCHER", "TICKET"]`.
- **id** (string (uuid), optional): Unique identifier for this resource. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **message** (string, optional, nullable): Message value. Example: `"Request accepted for asynchronous processing."`.
- **notes** (string, optional, nullable): Notes value. Example: `"Vegetarian meal requested"`.
- **recipient** (Contact, optional): Recipient object.
- **reseller** (BookingActor, optional, nullable): Reseller value.
- **resellerReference** (string, optional, nullable): Reseller reference value. Example: `"RES-BOOK-10045"`.
- **seller** (BookingActor, optional, nullable): Seller value.
- **settlementMethod** (string, optional): Settlement method value. Example: `"DIRECT"`.
- **status** (string, required): Current status value. Possible values: `ON_HOLD`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`, `EXPIRED`, `REDEEMED`, `NO_SHOW`, `PENDING`, `REJECTED`, `REBOOKED`, `QUOTE` (the specification declares this set on `Booking`; here it types the field as a plain string). Example: `"CONFIRMED"`.
- **supplierReference** (string, optional, nullable): Supplier reference value. Example: `"SUP-BOOK-7782"`.
- **testMode** (boolean, optional): Whether test mode is enabled. Example: `false`.
- **updatable** (boolean, optional): Whether updatable is enabled. Example: `true`.
- **user** (BookingActor, optional, nullable): User value.
- **utcConfirmedAt** (string (date-time), optional, nullable): Utc confirmed at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **utcCreatedAt** (string (date-time), optional): Utc created at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **utcExpiresAt** (string (date-time), optional, nullable): Utc expires at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **utcRedeemedAt** (string (date-time), optional, nullable): Utc redeemed at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **utcUpdatedAt** (string (date-time), optional): Utc updated at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **uuid** (string, required): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"gift_20260514_ba21f7"`.
- **voucher** (Ticket, optional): Voucher object.
- **weight** (number, optional): Weight numeric value. Example: `0`.
- **cardPayment** (CardPayment, optional, nullable): From capability `octo/cardPayments`.
- **returnUrl** (string, optional, nullable): From capability `octo/cardPayments`. Example: `"https://checkout.city-sightseeing.com/return"`.

- **orderInvoicePdfUrl** (string, optional, nullable). Example: `"https://www.city-sightseeing.com"`.
- **orderReference** (string, optional, nullable). Example: `"ORDER-2026-0514-1001"`.

## `Supplier`

## `WhoAmI`

- **partner** (string, optional): Partner value. Example: `"reseller_partner"`.
